sn51.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn51.10:1.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
sn51.10:1.4: vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
sn51.10:1.7: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā nisīdanaṃ ādāya bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
sn51.10:2.1: atha kho bhagavā yena pāvālacetiyaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn51.10:2.2: āyasmāpi kho ānando bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn51.10:2.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
sn51.10:3.1: ramaṇīyā ānanda vesālī ramaṇīyaṃ udenacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ sattambacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtakacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ sārandadacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ pāvālacetiyaṃ.
sn51.10:3.2: yassa kassaci ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā so ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā.
sn51.10:3.3: tathāgatassa kho ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. ākaṅkhamāno ānanda tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vāti.
sn51.10:4.1: evaṃpi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ
sn51.10:4.3: tiṭṭhatu bhante bhagavā kappaṃ tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
sn51.10:5.2: tatiyaṃpi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi

sn51.10:6.3: tiṭṭhatu bhante bhagavā kappaṃ tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
sn51.10:7.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi

sn51.10:8.1: atha kho māro pāpimā (acirapakkante āyasmante ānande) yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā (ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho māro pāpimā) bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn51.10:9.1: parinibbātudāni bhante bhagavā parinibbātu sugato parinibbānakālodāni bhante bhagavato.
sn51.10:9.2: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante bhagavatā vācā
sn51.10:9.3: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhū na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantīti.
sn51.10:10.1: santi kho pana bhante etarahi bhikkhū bhagavato sāvakā viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
sn51.10:10.2: parinibbātudāni bhante bhagavā parinibbātu sugato parinibbānakālodāni bhante bhagavato.
sn51.10:11.1: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante bhagavatā vācā

sn51.10:13.2: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me upāsakā …pe…
sn51.10:13.3: yāva me upāsikā na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantīti.
sn51.10:14.2: upāsikā bhagavato sāvikā viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena sunig gahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
sn51.10:14.3: parinibbātudāni bhante bhagavā parinibbātu sugato parinibbānakālodāni bhante bhagavato.
sn51.10:15.1: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante bhagavatā vācā
sn51.10:15.2: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na iddhañceva bhavissati phītañca vitthāritaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitanti.
sn51.10:15.3: tayidaṃ bhante bhagavato brahmacariyaṃ iddhañceva phītañca vitthāritaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ.
sn51.10:15.4: parinibbātudāni bhante bhagavā parinibbātu sugato parinibbānakālodāni bhante bhagavatoti.
sn51.10:16.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etadavoca
sn51.10:16.2: appossukko tvaṃ pāpima hohi na ciraṃ tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati
sn51.10:16.3: ito tiṇṇaṃ māsānaṃ accayena tathāgato parinibbāyissatīti.
sn51.10:17.1: atha kho bhagavā pāvāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajji.
sn51.10:17.2: ossaṭṭhe ca bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako lomahaṃso devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
sn51.10:17.3: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
